about: Shared vectors for the medium configure line (#1252). core/cliecho's configure_golden_1252_test.go checks Echo against every case and rewrites this file with UPDATE_GOLDEN=1; ui/shared's destinationConfigureCommands.test.ts checks the browser's copy against the same cases, so the two cannot drift apart unnoticed.

configure_cases.name: a local volume's path is a field like any other
configure_cases.line: retnd medium configure usb_disk --backend local_volume --field path=/mnt/usb --field prefix=retnd

configure_cases.name: the preflight is the same line with --preflight
configure_cases.line: retnd medium configure usb_disk --backend local_volume --field path=/mnt/usb --preflight

configure_cases.name: fields sorted by id, a split value quoted, the credential a reference
configure_cases.line: retnd medium configure cold --backend s3 --field 'bucket=acme backups' --field region=eu-central-1 --field storage_class=DEEP_ARCHIVE --credentials-id cred_01HX

configure_cases.name: userinfo in an endpoint is cut out
configure_cases.line: retnd medium configure cold --backend s3 --field bucket=b --field endpoint=https://minio.internal:9000

configure_cases.name: an endpoint the cut cannot read is held back, and the line says it will not run
configure_cases.line: retnd medium configure cold --backend s3 --field bucket=b --field <endpoint=the value, left out because it looks like it carries credentials> --credentials-id cred_01HX --preflight
